trap.label: tempo definido
trap.why: Em português usamos “têm pesquisado” de forma flexível. Em inglês, data definida (in 2015, yesterday) exige Past Simple; Present Perfect não aceita ponto fechado no passado.

fix.wrong: She have lived here for years.
fix.right: She has lived here for years.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no Present Perfect: “I read three books.” (até agora)
Reescreva no Past Simple, com in 2015: “They have surveyed adults.”
rewrite.why: Aceita a ordem com in 2015 no início.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com since: “We have lived here for six years.” (desde 2019)
